speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma.

The combination of hyperinflated lungs, a reduced FEV1/FVC ratio indicating airway obstruction, and the presence of atopic markers (implied by the investigation for eczema/allergies) despite normal tryptase strongly points to an obstructive airway disease. Given the specific pattern of symptoms and test results, I am confident in this diagnosis.
